text:
kai-se: Customer wants air-gapped POC: they need bundle provenance (notary), support for customer HSM signing, and a documented emergency rollback if a signing key is compromised.

lina-pm: summary: doable but needs Private deployment + config. We must define transport (minibundles vs full image), revocation flow, and who owns keys.

omar-eng: we currently produce COSE-signed bundles and minibundle deltas. For customer HSM, we can accept signed attest blobs at install time. Offline verifier checks manifest hash + signer fingerprint.

nina-sec: two options for emergency rollback: 1) pre-signed rollback tokens generated by customer HSM (recommended), or 2) delegated emergency signer stored in vendor escrow (more liability). Need legal sign-off and revocation distribution (signed CRL or short-lived tokens).

sam-sales: pricing Qs: Is HSM integration an add-on? What about CRL delivery and emergency on-call?

omar-eng: scoping inputs for quoting: host count, expected patch cadence (weekly/biweekly/monthly), minibundle vs full-image, and whether vendor hosts a VPC notary.

lina-pm: upgrade cadence guidance: suggest batching micro-patches into monthly minibatches for air-gapped sites to reduce transfers; security patches can be pushed faster if customer accepts more frequent shipments. Document tradeoffs in SOW.

legalbot: require indemnity clause when customer owns keys; if vendor signs in emergency, include explicit auth and escrow terms. SLA for emergency assist possible with premium support.

kai-se: can eng/security draft a one-pager runbook + threat checklist and sales draft pricing tiers? Customer wants SOW draft by EOD Friday.

deploy-bot: Ticket INF-9921 created: "airgap notary + rollback SOW" assigned to omar-eng and nina-sec.

sam-sales: I'll reach out to confirm host counts and whether they prefer cosign-compatible artifacts. :thumbsup:
